title: MODE 1: COMP (General Computation)
summary: Default mode for arithmetic, trig, logs, fractions, sexagesimal, Pol/Rec, FACT, and exact surds.

body.text: COMP is everyday work. With MthIO, results often stay as exact fractions or surds until you press S⇔D for a decimal.
Angle unit (Deg/Rad/Gra) and MthIO vs LineIO are SET UP options—wrong angle unit is a common exam trap.
